m1.typescript: m1 tasks run in order and receive the results of the tasks they need

e1.typescript: e1 every retry of a task carries the same idempotency key

e2.typescript: e2 retries stop at the limit and a fatal failure is not retried

e3.typescript: e3 a failure stays inside its branch and dependents are skipped

e4.typescript: e4 a breaker stops calls to an agent that keeps failing and a success resets it

e5.typescript: e5 a fallback degrades one task with its own key and is not checkpointed

e6.typescript: e6 a second run resumes from the checkpoint and retries only what failed

e7.typescript: e7 an unexpected crash is not swallowed and keeps the work already checkpointed

wrong-key-changes-late.defect: sends a new idempotency key from the third attempt on

wrong-one-more-attempt.defect: makes one call more than the limit when the limit is three

wrong-dependents-still-run.defect: runs a task whose dependency failed

wrong-breaker-total.defect: counts every failure of an agent and never resets on a success

wrong-breaker-never-opens.defect: keeps calling an agent that has failed past the threshold

wrong-fallback-same-key.defect: sends the primary's idempotency key to the fallback agent

wrong-fallback-checkpointed.defect: checkpoints a degraded result as if it were final

wrong-resume-reruns.defect: runs the tasks that the checkpoint already holds

wrong-crash-swallowed.defect: turns an unexpected crash into a failed task
